evidence: Publisher generator renders first three entries as preferred and last three as unfavored. Historical importer reads ordered stage labels from SSBU Stage Guides. Importer history does not prove every row was produced by that script.
uncertainty: No votes, sample counts, individual scores or collection dates supplied.
No claim of matchup-specific or current optimal play.
Source omits Northern Cave and Hollow Bastion; do not append them as if ranked.
Original collection lineage and redistribution terms need review before publishing the derived snapshot.
policy: Preserve the recorded order after excluding stages outside the audited Elite pool. Richter is a separately attributed three-stage subset from the publisher page, not an assumed Simon clone. Empty/missing/disjoint profiles delegate to baseline. User may replace any order.
